orchestrators.name: jarvis
orchestrators.description: Main orchestrator responsible for analyzing the user query and deciding which agent or tool should be invoked.

agents.name: system_operations
agents.description: Agent responsible for performing system-level operations such as executing terminal commands.

tools.name: terminal
tools.description: Execute commands in the system terminal and return the command output.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Once the orchestrator done all its processes to complete the user query, it has to call this tool to notify the user it has been completed. Or just use it to talk to the user or ask a question
